target.value: Enhanced capacities of the border agencies to provide initial and continuous training to border agents

actual.value: Overall completion progress estimated to 62.5 % assessed as follow: Development of pedagogical sheets 62.5% (20/32). Development of training courses: 62.5% (20/32). Training of trainers sessions: 47% (15/32). Regarding the number of certified trainers, we are at the level of 45 trainers out of 75 (60%). The project will carry on the certification of the remaining 30 trainers during the next phase of the project. Also, an ISO certification for the subcommittee members was conducted to equip them with the skills in sitting up scientific and pedagogical committee for the interagency training centre as well as evaluating/approving curricula and trainers selection.
